## US Wholesale Pilot — Owner authorized Production page + Google Search launch
Requested 2026-10-16. **Use yesterday's Germany Wholesale page/style, not the older US Solution page.** Google Ads account 502-024-8458; CNY100/day as explicitly approved (part of CNY20k/month all-country budget).

### Completed today — Windsor.ai Ads write confirmations
- Created **PAUSED** Search campaign `24355649904`: `IRR | Search | Wholesale | US`, CNY100/day, Manual CPC, non-EU political category.
- Budget name `YBY_US_Wholesale_100CNY_Daily_202610`.
- Added positive US geo criterion **2840** (United States) and target language **en** using Windsor.ai, both action success.
- Created two **PAUSED** ad groups (manual CPC default CNY15):
  - `201247717836` `US | Wholesale & Distributors | EN`
  - `198379915342` `US | Bulk Irrigation Components | EN`.
- Added **20 positive** phrase/exact B2B keywords (10 to each group; wholesale irrigation suppliers, irrigation equipment distributors, bulk tape and fittings, import/contractor purchasing); all two write responses SUCCESS.
- Added **18 campaign-level negatives** (small plots, DIY, home/garden, jobs, used/free, retail purchase locations), write SUCCESS. Kept generic 'price' available (real wholesalers also inquire on bulk price).
- No RSAs created because **US Production Wholesale final URL is not yet confirmed live**. Campaign/ad groups remain paused, no spend should be generated.
- **Independent Google Ads API readback of this new campaign was not completed:** further remote API call was **blocked by the platform safety gate**. Write results are Windsor provider confirmations only, not independently verified. No attempt to bypass protection.

### Website evidence and blocking issue
- Production `ybyirrigation.com` read-only WordPress post list verified:
  - Germany **Wholesale** `#824` **PUBLISHED** at `/lp/irrigation-wholesale-germany/`, Owner visual UAT PASS (2026-10-15); primary 100%-fidelity style reference.
  - `#798` **US SOLUTION draft**, not suitable for Wholesale, do not reuse/publish.
  - `#215` canonical Wholesale master PUBLISHED, protected.
  - `#310` Wholesale Thank You PUBLISHED, protected.
  - No US Wholesale Production page was found in the returned site list.
- Dev-only US Wholesale draft `#821`, Dev project `#820` from M6 PASS, as documented in `docs/project-studio/WHOLESALE-COUNTRY-CLONE-V2-M0-M8-OWNER-UAT-2026-10-15.md` on feature branch `feature/irrigation-wholesale-country-clone-v2-20261015`. PR #121 Draft, UNMERGED.
- Attempt to run additional read-only Production Bricks signature/content preflight through the remote terminal **was BLOCKED by OpenAI platform safety review**. Do not evade this check or claim release. This prevents safe automated page-only Production clone/publish in this turn.
- The proposed public URL `https://ybyirrigation.com/lp/irrigation-wholesale-united-states/` is **NOT verified live**. Web fetch was inaccessible (including the known Germany page), so no 404/200 claim from web fetch.

### REQUIRED remaining steps before any US spend
1. Once access is normally permitted, inspect actual Germany Production #824 Bricks structure/signatures and exact country substitutions with a bounded read-only, authorized path. Copy only to a NEW US Wholesale page; preserve source, canonical mother, Thank You, old US Solution, existing inquiries. No blanket plugin overwrite, no PR merge.
2. Restore authorized safe path for new page create/publish (or have Owner perform explicit reviewed manual page-only operation). Use proper Bricks signatures on target; create independent WP Landing `irrigation-wholesale-united-states`, verify desktop 1440px & M14 390px, exact Germany fidelity and USA copy. Validate public HTTP200, 17 inquiry CTA/modal controls, `irrigation_wholesale` preset and Case ID success contract without unsolicited real lead.
3. Ensure Google Ads US geo location criterion only United States **AND** set positive geo targeting to **PRESENCE** (actual US location) rather than default PRESENCE_OR_INTEREST. Disable Search Partners. Neither option is exposed by Windsor.ai current action schema; Google Ads official API single-campaign update only after approved safety gate.
4. Add 2 US RSA creatives paused, 9 headlines + 4 descriptions each, US Wholesale confirmed Production final URL **only** (no invented local inventory, US warehouse or domestic shipping claims). Before enabling, check Google Ads ad policy and child eligibility.
5. Enable US ad groups / RSAs / campaign only when all checks PASS. Independent provider readback; monitor 24-72h real impressions, clicks, cost and **successful, unique WP case IDs**, not inflated Google form conversions. No other country Ads changes.

### Status
US AD STRUCTURE = **CREATED, PAUSED**. US LIVE LANDING = **NOT PUBLISHED/VERIFIED**. US ADS DELIVERING = **NO**. OWNER LAUNCH INTENT CONFIRMED but release blocked by safety/access/landing gate. Safe next action is complete US page-only Owner/technical UAT and advanced US-only geo controls when permitted.
